title: Renew an adult passport
kw: passport renewal renew expired expiring passport online adult new passport passaporte renovar pas
short: If you are 18 or over and have had an Irish passport before, renew it on Passport Online. The form takes about 10 minutes and works from anywhere in the world.
who: Irish citizens aged 18 or over who already have, or had, an Irish passport.
If your last passport was issued more than 15 years ago, you apply as a first-time applicant instead: see [First adult passport](#/s/passport-first-adult).
need: A digital photo that meets the [photo guidelines](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/passports/photo-guidelines/). Someone else must take it (no selfies, no zoom), or a pharmacy or photo shop can give you a photo code.
Your current or most recent passport.
A debit or credit card and an email address.
steps: Get your digital photo ready.
Open **Passport Online**, choose the adult renewal, fill in your details, upload the photo and pay by card.
At the end, Passport Online tells you if you need to post anything. If your passport expires within 12 months you normally keep it; if it has longer left, you post it in.
Keep your 11-digit application number and follow progress on the [Passport Tracker](https://passporttracking.dfa.ie/passporttracking).
The new passport comes by post. Your old one is cancelled within 4 weeks of you receiving the new one.

cases.q: My name has changed
a: For a married name, send your civil marriage or civil partnership certificate. For other name changes you need documents showing you have used the new name for at least 2 years.
A renewal with a name change counts as a complex renewal: about 15 working days instead of 10.

cases.q: My passport was lost, stolen or damaged
a: You still renew online and report it there. See [Lost, stolen or damaged passport](#/s/passport-lost).

cases.q: I am travelling soon
a: Use Passport Online if you travel in the next 3 months: paper applications take at least 6 weeks. If you need it within days, see [Urgent passport](#/s/passport-urgent).

cases.q: I live outside Ireland
a: You renew the same way on Passport Online. There is an extra €15 postal fee and delivery takes longer.

cases.q: I cannot or do not want to apply online
a: If you live in Ireland or Northern Ireland, phone the **Passport Assist Service** on 01 613 1795 for a pre-filled paper form, then send it by Post Passport from a post office. It costs €80 plus a €9.50 service fee and takes at least 6 weeks.
The old green APS1 and APS2 paper forms have not been accepted since 1 December 2025.

cases.q: I also want a Passport Card
a: Order both together on Passport Online for €100. See [Passport Card](#/s/passport-card).

tips: Times are averages, not a guarantee. They count from the day the Passport Service has everything it needs and do not include postage.
Before you book, check the entry rules of the country you are visiting with the airline or that country’s embassy.

title: Get your first adult passport
kw: first passport first time new passport never had passport apply irish passport adult naturalised citizen passport primeiro passaporte
short: You apply online, then a Garda (or an approved witness if you live abroad) confirms your identity and you post original documents. Do not book travel until the passport arrives.
facts: About 20 working days after your documents arrive
who: Irish citizens aged 18 or over who have never had an Irish passport, or whose last one was issued more than 15 years ago.
You must already be an Irish citizen: by birth, through an Irish parent, through the [Foreign Births Register](#/s/citizenship-fbr) or by [naturalisation](#/s/citizenship).
need: A digital photo, a debit or credit card, an email address and a printer.
Your **full original civil birth certificate** showing your parents’ names.

One proof of name and one proof of address, dated in the last 12 months. They must be two different documents. Government letters (Social Protection, Revenue) are preferred; utility bills or bank statements also work.
Photo ID. If you live in Ireland: a photocopy of your [Public Services Card](#/s/psc), or original government photo ID.
Your marriage or civil partnership certificate if you apply in a married name.
steps: Check the exact list for your situation on [Documentary requirements](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/passports/documentary-requirements/adult/).
Apply and pay on **Passport Online**.
Print the **Identity Verification Form** it gives you. In Ireland a member of An Garda Síochána must sign it: bring it to a Garda station with your photo ID.
Post the form and your original documents to the address shown. Originals are returned to you.
Follow progress with your 11-digit application number on the [Passport Tracker](https://passporttracking.dfa.ie/passporttracking).

cases.q: I became Irish by naturalisation
a: Send your original naturalisation certificate, your full birth certificate, proof of name and address, and two photo IDs: your original foreign passport or national ID, plus a photocopy of your Public Services Card or a certified driving licence.

cases.q: I am on the Foreign Births Register
a: Send your original Foreign Birth Registration certificate (or a colour copy certified by a solicitor or notary), your full birth certificate, proof of name and address, and photo ID.

cases.q: I was born abroad to a parent born in Ireland
a: Add your Irish-born parent’s full original civil birth certificate. If their name differs between documents, add their marriage certificate.

cases.q: I live outside Ireland
a: The identity form is signed by an approved witness who lives in the same country as you, for example a police officer, doctor, lawyer, teacher, bank manager or notary. They must stamp it and give a work landline number. There is an extra €15 postal fee.

cases.q: I cannot apply online
a: If you live in Ireland or Northern Ireland, phone the Passport Assist Service on +353 1 613 1795.

cases.q: I am not an Irish citizen
a: You cannot get an Irish passport. For proof of identity in Ireland see [Which ID can I get?](#/s/id-options). To become a citizen see [Become an Irish citizen](#/s/citizenship).

tips: First-time applications cannot be fast-tracked. The Passport Service asks you not to book travel until you have the passport.
The clock only starts when your documents reach the Passport Service.

title: Get or renew a child’s passport
kw: child passport baby passport kids children under 18 guardian consent first passport for a child renew child passport passaporte criança filho
short: Every child under 18 needs their own passport. You apply online, all guardians sign a consent form in front of a witness, and you post the documents. It lasts 5 years.
facts: Renewal about 15 working days; first passport about 20
who: Any Irish citizen under 18. A parent or guardian applies for them.
Children can no longer be added to a parent’s passport.
Renew when the child’s passport has 6 months or less left. If their last passport was issued more than 15 years ago, apply as a first-time applicant.
need: A digital photo of the child, a card, an email address and a printer.
The consent of **all** the child’s guardians.

First passport: the child’s original birth certificate, plus documents that depend on your situation ([born in Ireland](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/passports/documentary-requirements/child/), [born abroad](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/passports/documentary-requirements/)).
steps: Apply and pay on **Passport Online**. It lists the documents you must send.
Print the **Child Passport Identity and Consent Form**. The link is emailed to you and works for 5 days.

One guardian brings the child to a witness who knows the child. The witness confirms the child’s identity and watches that guardian sign. The other guardian signs in front of the same or another witness.
For a **first** passport in Ireland, the witness for the child’s identity must be a Garda. For a renewal in Ireland, a Garda is no longer required: other listed witnesses are accepted.
Post the form and documents. Processing starts when everything has arrived.

cases.q: I am the child’s only guardian
a: Send a [Sole Guardian Affidavit (AFF1)](https://www.ireland.ie/543/Annex-F1-Sole-Guardian-Affidavit-EN.pdf), completed in front of a solicitor or commissioner for oaths, with the child’s original birth certificate.

cases.q: The other guardian will not or cannot consent
a: You need a court order dispensing with that guardian’s consent. Send the original order and the child’s original birth certificate.

cases.q: The other guardian has died
a: Send the original death certificate with the first application after the death, the AFF1 affidavit and the child’s birth certificate. If a testamentary guardian was named in a will, they must consent too.

cases.q: We live outside Ireland
a: Consent must be witnessed in the country where you live. The postal fee is a single €15.

cases.q: We need it urgently
a: Only renewals can use the urgent service. See [Urgent passport](#/s/passport-urgent).

tips: A Passport Card for a child is only sold as a bundle with the passport: €45 online.

title: Replace a lost, stolen or damaged passport
kw: lost passport stolen passport damaged passport missing report passport replace perdi passaporte roubado
short: Report it and apply for the replacement in one go on Passport Online. A passport reported lost or stolen can never be used again, even if you find it.
need: A digital photo, a card, an email address and a printer.
If the passport is damaged: the damaged passport itself, which you must send back.
steps: **In Ireland:** report the loss or theft to the Gardaí to protect yourself from identity fraud, and tell the Passport Service.
Apply for a new passport on **Passport Online** straight away and report the old one lost or stolen in the form. This is the fastest way to stop anyone else travelling on it.
Send any documents Passport Online asks for and follow progress on the [Passport Tracker](https://passporttracking.dfa.ie/passporttracking).

cases.q: It happened while I am abroad
a: Report it to the local police and ask for a written statement. Then contact the nearest [Irish embassy or consulate](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/embassies/): they can issue an emergency travel document to get you home.
If there is no Irish embassy, the embassy of another EU country may issue an EU Emergency Travel Document.

cases.q: My passport is damaged
a: Do not travel on it. Apply for a replacement and return the damaged passport with your application.

cases.q: I found it after reporting it
a: Do not travel on it. Its details have been reported to Interpol and it is no longer valid.

cases.q: I have lost passports before
a: If you have lost 2 or more passports, you may be given a passport that is valid for less than 10 years.

cases.q: I must travel because of an emergency
a: For a death or medical emergency of a family member abroad, phone the Passport Service on 01 671 1633 or use WebChat. See [Urgent passport](#/s/passport-urgent).

act: Report and replace on Passport Online

title: Get a passport urgently
kw: urgent passport emergency passport same day fast track rush appointment mount street cork london emergency travel document passaporte urgente
short: The Urgent Appointment Service renews a passport in 1 or 4 days, by appointment only, in Dublin or Cork (5 days in London). It is for renewals only.
facts: Dublin, Cork or London, by appointment
who: People **renewing** a passport. First-time applicants cannot use it, and neither can anyone whose last passport was issued more than 15 years ago.
Slots are limited and given first come, first served.
need: Adults: four identical passport photos, no more than 6 months old, and your most recent Irish passport. If it was lost or stolen, bring photo ID and proof of your name.

Children: four photos, the child’s most recent passport, the child’s original long birth certificate and the signed, witnessed consent form. Same-day service: the child and all guardians attend with ID. Four-day service: at least one guardian attends.
steps: Book a slot on the **urgent appointment booking page**. Same-day slots open up to 3 days ahead; 4-day and 5-day slots up to 3 weeks ahead.
Go to the office at your appointment time with your photos and passport.
Collect the passport: the same day in Dublin, or after 4 days in Dublin or Cork.

cases.q: How much does each option cost?
a: Same day (Dublin): €245 for an adult, €195 for a child.
Four days (Dublin or Cork) or five days (London): €170 for an adult, €120 for a child.
The price includes the passport itself (€95 adult, €45 child at the counter) plus the appointment fee.

cases.q: A family member abroad has died or is seriously ill
a: The Passport Service has a same-day emergency service for a medical emergency or the death of a family member abroad. You pay only the passport fee and must show supporting documents. Phone 01 671 1633 or use [WebChat](https://www.ireland.ie/en/dfa/passports/contact-us/).

cases.q: I need a first passport quickly
a: First-time applications cannot be expedited. Apply online as early as you can: see [First adult passport](#/s/passport-first-adult).

cases.q: My name has changed
a: The same-day service cannot change a name. The 4-day and 5-day services can, but only after marriage, civil partnership, divorce, separation or a court order.

tips: You can cancel up to 24 hours before the appointment from the link in your confirmation email. You cannot move an appointment: cancel and book again.

title: Get a Passport Card
kw: passport card credit card size id card travel europe wallet card cartão passaporte
short: A credit-card-sized passport for Irish citizens. It works for travel in the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, and is handy as photo ID.
who: Irish citizens who hold a valid Irish passport book. Your details must match the passport book exactly.
Adults can order a card on its own if the passport book has at least 3 months left.
Under-18s can only get it as a bundle when applying for the passport.
need: A digital photo, a card to pay and an email address.
steps: Open **Passport Online** and choose the Passport Card (or the passport and card bundle).
Upload your photo, pay and wait for the card by post.

cases.q: How long is it valid?
a: Up to 5 years. If your passport book has less than 5 years left, the card expires on the same date as the book.

cases.q: I need a passport too
a: Order the bundle: €100 for an adult passport and card, €45 for a child.

cases.q: Can I fly to the United States with it?
a: No. It is only valid for the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.
